notes.title: EPSTEIN 2 Released! EPSTEIN 1 Big Update !
notes.content:
New Update: September 6: Double Threat! EPSTEIN's Big Update and the Horror-Filled EPSTEIN 2 Release on the Same Date!

Epstein 2: Dive into the Depths of a Single-Player Horror Story!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839404/4f5156388e4b81a495097676f3cdc9e16f21aae3.png

Epstein 2 pulls you into a hair-raising story. As Detective Michael, you will step onto the dark and mysterious Epstein Island, where your mother was kidnapped. While tracking her down, you will uncover secrets that challenge the limits of the human mind. With increasing tension and uncertainty at every step, this single-player horror adventure will keep you on the edge of your seat. Epstein 2 offers a masterful blend of fear and narrative.

Epstein 2 will be released in full on September 6. Prepare yourself for this date, and get ready to solve the mystery and face the dark side of fear!

Hello dear players!

With Epstein's exciting new update, another mysterious island has been added to the 8 enigmatic ones! Along with this update, a new boss who collaborates with Epstein has joined the game: BALL GATES. On this new island, dark secrets are revealed, and it's discovered that people are being morbidly transformed through horrific experiments. Our main character embarks on this terrifying journey, overcoming all challenges to finally face and defeat Ball Gates. Get ready because the tension and adventure in Epstein have never been deeper!

We hope these updates make your gaming experience richer and more thrilling. Your feedback is very valuable to us, so please don't hesitate to share your thoughts. We wish you all happy gaming!

notes.title: Epstein Big Update 2.0
notes.content:
New Update: Discovery of the Mysterious Islands

Hello dear players!

In the past few weeks, based on the feedback we received from you, we have worked intensively to add new content to our game, Epstein, and to fix existing issues. Today, we want to share with you the significant updates we've made during this process and the modifications inspired by our community's valuable members.

Highlighted Updates:

Bug Fixes: Issues such as glitches and item disappearances have been resolved. A smoother gaming experience awaits you.
Major Fixes:

Physical Interactions: Improvements have been made on the physical interactions within the game, offering a more realistic experience.
Interactive Items: Work has been done on interactive items and their physical responses, enhancing the game's realism.
Exciting Innovations:

Sonic Radar: The "Sonic Radar" feature has been added to ease gameplay. By pressing the "Q" key, you can easily detect collectible items and enemies vulnerable to attack around your character.
Mysterious Islands: Eight new and enigmatic islands await discovery. Filled with mysteries, you will collect equipment on these islands, reach the final island of Epstein, battle tough bosses, and lose yourself in our deepening story.

In Pursuit of a Dark Secret:
Our lawyer friend has secretly infiltrated the island to uncover a dark secret threatening humanity. However, if we lose contact with him, it becomes our mission to unravel this mystery and save the island's people.

With these updates, we hope to enrich and excite your gaming experience. Your feedback is very important to us, so please don't hesitate to share your thoughts with us. We wish you all enjoyable gaming!

notes.title: March 22th Big Update: Epstein Island - The Adrenosoft Mystery!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839404/e2ecf84c3f09fe148e2b6317772fea20a13831a2.png

Hello adventurers!

As we step by step advance in the gaming world, we're thrilled to share with you the biggest update to our "Epstein" game. The update will be live on March 22th.

In this update, we've fixed many of the bugs found by our community. The map is completely changing and being set into a story.

New Islands, New Adventures:
Eight new and mysterious islands await discovery. In these islands filled with mysteries, you'll gather equipment, reach the game's final island, Epstein Island, battle tough bosses, and lose yourself in our deepening story.

Pursuing the Dark Secret:
Our lawyer friend has secretly infiltrated the island to expose a dark secret threatening humanity. However, if we lose contact with him, it becomes our mission to solve this mystery and save the island's inhabitants.

Be ready for surprises and the update on March 22th!

Galaxyverse Dev Team.
